structured.answer: Harel has 105 products. Most charge about 0.5% a year, and the S&P 500 tracks are up about 13.7% a year over 3 years (stock tracks about 21%). The cheapest S&P fund (מחקה, about 0.1%) shows no return at all, so I still don't know where to put my 30k.

stuck.where: Most track rows in the big table
stuck.why: Instead of a return they say 'פחות מ־3 שנים / פחות מ־5 שנים', so half the tracks can't be compared
Fees are split into קבועים, משתנים and נאמן and there's no return column, so I can't compare them with the S&P tracks above
Screens of rows that all look alike; I got bored and would have closed the page here on my phone
Two numbers per row, ההיסכון and ההפקדות, sometimes 'אין' or 'עוד לא דווח'; I didn't know which one I'd actually pay

findings.what: Huge single table, 96 tracks with near-identical rows; much too long on a phone
Fees only as percents, two per row (ההיסכון / ההפקדות), with 'אין' and 'עוד לא דווח' unexplained
Fund fees split into קבועים/משתנים/נאמן, a different format from the table above
Tags like צוברת, מנוטרלת מט"ח, מס גם על שינויי המטבע mean nothing to me
'לפני דמי ניהול' is in small text in the column header and easy to miss
